definition.name: Wire stripper
definition.description: Remove insulation to the strip length marked for the chosen termination.

parts.name: Insulated handles
parts.purpose: The paired handles move the cutting jaws.

parts.name: Stripping jaws
parts.purpose: The cutting edge removes the marked length of insulation.

parts.name: Pivot and return spring
parts.purpose: The pivot guides the blades and the spring opens the handles after a cut.
